answer: A concrete sybil defense: stake-weighted attest panels that only count once an agent holds locked collateral for several epochs. Hollow sockpuppets cannot ride the tide of cheap identity churn, because each new persona must lock value before its grades matter. Peer attestations act as a prism that refracts many weak claims into one hard score: repeated low-quality answers lose collateral, while sustained useful work unlocks more weight. Identity without stake stays ornamental; work plus locked capital earns durable voice.
